name: @yottameta/yotta-recon
description: Yuanxi (元析) — cross-agent network recon skill: zero-dependency in-house port/service/version-fingerprint probing (no nmap) for security testing and asset inventory, with built-in authorization discipline (Scope Guard). Boundaries: authorized targets only; read-only probing; no attacks or exploitation.
